scope: Follow-up AI verification; manufacturer documentation plus explicitly labeled technical-publication supplement. Original repository-only dataset is unchanged.

sources.title: BIOMONITOR IV — Intelligent SmartECG
sources.quote: False positive AF detections may take a considerable amount of time to review. That’s why SmartECG is supported by AI for AF detection to analyze 100s of data points across each individual ECG and streamline data evaluation.
sources.supports: Explicit manufacturer AI claim for AF review; not all arrhythmia filtering is AI.
sources.limitations: Manufacturer statement; no independent code or model audit.

sources.title: First global implantation of BIOMONITOR IV
sources.quote: AI algorithm is applied only to AF detection
sources.supports: AI scope limited to AF; contemporaneous with device launch.
sources.limitations: Press release; performance data-on-file claims not imported into the dataset.

sources.title: Implantable cardiac monitors: artificial intelligence and signal processing reduce remote ECG review workload and preserve arrhythmia detection sensitivity
sources.locator: Materials and methods / SmartECG algorithm; Discussion / Remote vs. in-office follow-up
sources.quote: SmartECG is a software package implemented in the HMSC for the BioMonitor IV ICM.
sources.supports: External execution location: Home Monitoring Service Center (HMSC), not implant.
sources.limitations: Biotronik-funded, with manufacturer-employed authors. Analysis used BioMonitor IIIm recordings adapted to IV transmission limits; not a prospective IV-only cohort. Technical architecture evidence only; no outcome values imported.
sources.additional_quote: The SmartECG algorithm is implemented in the remote monitoring platform because it cannot be implemented in the ICM or in the programming device used to interrogate the ICM during a follow-up visit.
sources.af_scope_quote: For the analysis of AF events only, it further uses artificial intelligence, which can be set to different levels of strictness, from very sensitive to very specific.

sources.title: Medtronic receives FDA approval for its next generation Micra leadless pacing systems
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning The new Micra AV2
sources.quote: The new Micra AV2 also includes advanced algorithms that automatically program AV synchrony, thereby coordinating the heart's upper and lower chambers.
sources.supports: Automatic AV-synchrony programming for AV2; launch covers AV2 and VR2.
sources.limitations: No explicit AI/ML mechanism or training description. Shared product release does not transfer AV2 AV-synchrony features to VR2.

sources.title: Why AVEIR Dual Chamber
sources.quote: This novel technology features paired, co-implanted devices employing low-energy, subthreshold pulses between them using the conductive nature of the body’s blood pool and myocardial tissue.
sources.supports: i2i is implant-to-implant communication supporting synchronized pacing, not evidence of AI.
sources.limitations: Current page includes later-generation components and cites 2025 evidence. No assumption that all current features existed in February 2024. No explicit AI/ML description found.

sources.title: EMBLEM MRI S-ICD System — technical specifications and mCRM System
sources.locator: Technical specifications / Automatic functions / SMART pass; mCRM System / mSYNC Communication
sources.quote: High-pass filter designed to reduce oversensing while maintaining an appropriate sensing margin
sources.supports: SMART Pass is a high-pass signal filter. EMPOWER coordination is described as mSYNC device-to-device ATP requests; neither description establishes AI.
sources.limitations: Page principally documents EMBLEM MRI A219; do not retroactively assign every feature to the unspecified EMBLEM model in the original map. Manufacturer page labels EMPOWER/mCRM investigational in the US.
sources.additional_quote: In the mCRM System, mSYNC Communication is used by the EMBLEM S-ICD to wirelessly transmit ATP request signals to the EMPOWER Leadless Pacemaker.
